Hey guys, if I may,

When I first started looking into Supply and Demand I found Sam S work and used to think "shit, how does he do it?!" I never used to miss his webinars (even if they ran at 2am my time) and used to mark all his zones on my charts. I had a basic understanding on how it worked, but that was as far as it went, the very basics of supply and demand, and nothing of PA.

After IF brought us his online material, and after I started to learn it. I found myself less and less compelled to watch Sams webinars. Not because I didn't think they were good, but because I already knew what to look for, and WHY.

I think I have come a long way since I first found SD trading, and I don't even watch Sams webinars anymore as I can find all the important zones on the charts myself. Not only that but I understand the PA too! which we know is most of the story.

Again, Sams works are really cool to understand the basics, but the team here at RTM have really taken it to the next level.

~^o^~
